proposed_comments.body:
### Align with the existing Adaptive Card theme-refresh PR

**Severity:** `high`

Thanks for investigating and reproducing this issue. This PR overlaps with open PR 49817, which is already implementing the same Adaptive Card theme-refresh change in `ContentFormControl`; please coordinate with that work and consolidate the fixes into one canonical PR so the two solutions do not diverge. Please also complete the CLA agreement requested by the policy service before merge.
